mapper.insert: INSERT INTO therapeutics (id, therapeutics_code, therapeutics_name, therapeutics_name_pinyin, therapeutics_name_pinyin_abbr, description, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{therapeuticsCode}, #{therapeuticsName}, #{therapeuticsNamePinyin}, #{therapeuticsNamePinyinAbbr}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE therapeutics SET therapeutics_code = #{therapeuticsCode}, therapeutics_name = #{therapeuticsName}, therapeutics_name_pinyin = #{therapeuticsNamePinyin}, therapeutics_name_pinyin_abbr = #{therapeuticsNamePinyinAbbr}, description = #{description}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM therapeutics WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id FROM therapeutics WHERE therapeutics_code = #{therapeuticsCode} AND deleted_at = 0
